leads.title: The stat screen shows 27 m and 64 m spot-on-fire ranges for the M45A1 and vz. 61 (0 and 9 m suppressed); the site shows 54 and 150 (0 and 21)
leads.statusNote: Approved by the operator and applied 10 Oct in site commit b6da447 (on origin/main).
leads.summary: The operator's stat-screen screenshots show spot-on-fire ranges of 27 m and 64 m for the M45A1 and vz. 61 on every non-muzzle panel, and 0 and 9 m with a suppressor, against 54, 150 and 0, 21 on the P18; the stored WB values agree. Applied 10 October 2026: sim/applyAttachments.js uses base 27 / 64.285713 for m45a1 and vz61 and 54 / 150 for every other weapon (site commit b6da447).
